name: Cillaperlata (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with green triangles at the lower hoist and fly, charged at the centre with a yellow Virgin and Child beneath an arch.
history: Municipal flag of Cillaperlata; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangles at the lower hoist and lower fly
Virgin and Child seated beneath an arch
